name: Hida Bushi
skills: Athletics, Defense, Heavy Weapons (Tetsubo), Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: One of the Empire's oldest bushi styles, forged against the Shadowlands: endure the enemy's blows, then crush them with heavy weapons.

techniques.name: The Way of the Crab
techniques.text: Ignore TN penalties for wearing heavy armor (except for Stealth), and gain +1k0 to the total of all damage rolls with a Heavy Weapon.

techniques.name: The Mountain Does Not Move
techniques.text: Gain Reduction equal to your Earth Ring.

techniques.name: Two Pincers One Mind
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action instead of a Complex Action when using Heavy Weapons or Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Devastating Blow
techniques.text: Once per encounter with a Heavy Weapon, make a calculated strike that lowers the target's Reduction by 4; a successful hit also Dazes them, with the recovery TN dropping each time they fail to shake it off.

techniques.name: The Mountain Does Not Fall
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point in the Reactions Stage to act as if Healthy next Turn, ignoring Dazed, Fatigued, and Stunned until the next Reactions Stage.

name: Hida Pragmatist [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improvised Weapons) 2, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Students of Kobo Ichi-Kai, taught at Clear Water Village, who put unarmed fighting above every other kind. Their strength makes them fine yojimbo and a match even for Shadowlands creatures.

techniques.name: The Eternal Stone Unleashed
techniques.text: +1k0 to resist Intimidation/Fear, and +1k0 to unarmed or improvised-weapon attack and damage rolls — but you must always keep high dice on those boosted rolls.

techniques.name: Wearing Down the Mountain
techniques.text: The Extra Attack Maneuver costs only 3 Raises (instead of 5) when fighting unarmed or with an improvised weapon.

techniques.name: Fury of the Avalanche
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action when unarmed, using an improvised weapon, or wielding a Samurai-keyword weapon.

techniques.name: Stone Turns Steel Aside
techniques.text: A number of times per skirmish equal to your Void, after being hit by a melee attack you may take a Free Action to win a Contested Roll and turn the enemy's own weapon against them, using your own Strength for damage. Not usable in an iaijutsu duel.

techniques.name: Fight to the End
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to make a Complex-Action attack that ignores Wound penalties (even Down/Out) and status effects, dealing +3k1 damage.

name: Hiruma Bushi
skills: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth, any one Skill
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Bow with 20 Arrows or Knife, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Where the Hida endure, the Hiruma evade, striking weak points with lightning speed. Their School is built for movement and survival inside the Shadowlands.

techniques.name: Torch’s Flame Flickers
techniques.text: +1k0 to attack rolls while in the Attack Stance, and double the duration food/water/jade rations last for a number of people equal to your Hunting Rank.

techniques.name: Wolf’s Little Lesson
techniques.text: While in the Attack Stance, gain +5 Armor TN each time you hit with a melee weapon; stacks up to your School Rank times, lasting the rest of the skirmish.

techniques.name: Hummingbird Wings
techniques.text: Once per Round, spend a Void Point when targeted by an attack to gain double your School Rank as an Armor TN bonus against it, stacking with other Armor TN bonuses.

techniques.name: Shark Smells Blood
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action instead of Complex when using a Samurai-keyword weapon.

techniques.name: Daylight Wastes No Movement
techniques.text: If you deal more Wounds than needed to kill your target, carry the excess Wounds over to the next target you hit (not on consecutive attacks, and only within the current skirmish).

name: Kaiu Engineer [Artisan/Bushi]
skills: Battle, Craft: Armorsmithing, Craft: Weaponsmithing, Defense, Engineering, Lore: Architecture, War Fan
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or War Fan, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: The Empire's foremost builders, siege engineers and armourers, devoted to the Crab's defence against the Shadowlands. Many also lead troops, turning siegecraft to war.

techniques.name: The Kaiu Method
techniques.text: +1k0 on any School Skill Roll; spending a Void Point on a School Skill Roll grants +2k2 instead of +1k1 (the two bonuses don't stack).

techniques.name: The Path of Stone
techniques.text: When building a large structure, an Engineering roll (TN 25) adds Wounds equal to School Rank x100; when commanding a siege engine, reroll one damage die per shot that rolls below your School Rank.

techniques.name: The Path of the Shell
techniques.text: When crafting armor, spend double time/cost to add your School Rank to its Reduction, and half your School Rank (rounded up) to its Armor TN bonus.

techniques.name: The Path of War
techniques.text: Modify Mass Battle Chart results by up to half your School Rank; attack as a Simple Action with katana, dai tsuchi, or war fan.

techniques.name: The Path of Steel
techniques.text: When crafting a weapon, grant it +1k0 to attack rolls or +0k1 to damage; for a katana, you may spend all Void Points to make it unbreakable, at the cost of not recovering Void Points for a week.

name: Kuni Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Lore: Shadowlands 2, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one Weapon Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Thought of as obsessive madmen who delve into forbidden secrets, the Kuni accept that as the price of fighting the Shadowlands. Their alliance with the Nezumi gives them insight into other nonhumans.

techniques.name: Gaze Into Shadow
techniques.text: +1k0 on Spell Casting Rolls against non-human creatures; damage spells deal +1k1 against Tainted targets, and gain a Free Raise on any Jade-keyword spell.

name: Kuni Witch-Hunter [Monk]
skills: Investigation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Lore: Maho, Meditation, any one Skill
outfit: Rugged Clothing, Daisho, Knife, Jade Pendant, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: A small band of mystic warriors who roam the Empire hunting maho-tsukai and Shadowlands infiltrators, ignoring borders. Commoners welcome them; other samurai often do not.

techniques.name: To See the Darkness
techniques.text: Sense Taint in a target via a Contested Roll (Investigation/Awareness vs. Sincerity/Willpower), gaining +1k0 per full Rank of their Taint; also +1k1 to resist Taint and to attacks against Shadowlands creatures or known Tainted foes.

techniques.name: To Ride the Darkness
techniques.text: As a Free Action vs. a Shadowlands creature, roll Lore: Shadowlands/Intelligence (TN 20) to recall one strength or weakness of it, with Raises revealing more.

techniques.name: To Strike the Darkness
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action against Shadowlands creatures or known Tainted foes.

techniques.name: To Repel the Darkness
techniques.text: +3k0 to your Rank 1 and Rank 2 detection rolls, and learn one Kiho.

techniques.name: To Shatter the Darkness
techniques.text: +4k1 to attack and damage rolls against Shadowlands creatures and known Tainted foes, stacking with the Rank 1 bonus.

name: Toritaka Bushi
skills: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.

techniques.name: The Falcon’s Eyes
techniques.text: +1k0 on Perception-based Skill and Trait rolls, and +1k0 to damage against creatures from other Spirit Realms.

techniques.name: The Falcon Takes Flight
techniques.text: Roll Perception vs. TN equal to a nearby other-realm creature's Air Ring x5 to detect its presence.

techniques.name: The Falcon’s Wings
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with a spear or Samurai-keyword weapon.

techniques.name: Vigilant and Strong
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to negate darkness/blinding penalties for about two Rounds.

techniques.name: Claws of the Falcon
techniques.text: Ignore up to 5 points of an opponent's Reduction; spend a Void Point as a Free Action to reduce a Spirit-Realm creature's Reduction by 10 for a Round.

name: Yasuki Courtier
skills: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation, Sincerity (Deceit), any one Merchant Skill
outfit: Traditional Clothing, Wakizashi, Knife, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Once Crane, the Yasuki joined the Crab and became the Empire's richest merchants. Their courtiers are salesmen who find what a rival needs and supply it, at a price.

techniques.name: The Way of the Carp
techniques.text: Free Raise on Commerce with no Honor/Glory loss for using it publicly; Contested Roll (Commerce/Perception vs. Etiquette/Awareness) to discern what someone wants.

techniques.name: Do As We Say
techniques.text: A number of times per session equal to your School Rank, re-roll a failed Sincerity or Intimidation roll (must keep the second result).

techniques.name: Treasures of the Carp
techniques.text: Roll Commerce/Awareness (TN 20) to locate a rare item for someone; Raises find rarer items.

techniques.name: Wiles of the Carp
techniques.text: Anyone lying to or deceiving you socially faces a TN increase of 5x your School Rank.

techniques.name: What is Yours is Mine
techniques.text: If you help someone get something they want, gain +5k0 on Contested Social Rolls against them for 24 hours.

name: Hiruma Scout [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Bugei Skill
lore: After Hiruma Castle fell, the family lost the teachers of its old bushi School. The Hiruma Scouts are the stealthy style practised in that era.

techniques.name: Dance the Razor's Edge
techniques.text: Unless surprised or otherwise unaware, add Stealth Rank to Initiative. Food, water and jade rations last twice as long for a number of people equal to Hunting Rank. In the Shadowlands, gain +1k0 to Stealth and always know the direction and approximate distance to the Empire. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))

techniques.name: Run Like the Wind
techniques.text: You may take Free or Simple Move Actions in Full Defense. Run at high speed for Stamina plus School Rank hours, then become Exhausted until you rest for one hour. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))

techniques.name: Veil of the Spirits
techniques.text: While remaining still with cover, concealment or camouflage approved by the GM, spend 1 Void Point to add School Rank kept dice to Stealth. The benefit ends if you move or make noise. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))

techniques.name: Harness the Wind
techniques.text: Make attacks with Samurai weapons, knives or bows as Simple Actions. Against Shadowlands creatures or known Tainted nonhumans, this applies with any weapon. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))

techniques.name: Strike of the Stalker
techniques.text: Against a surprised or unaware opponent, your Raises have no Void-based limit and you ignore 10 points of Reduction. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))

name: Asahina Shugenja
skills: any one Artisan Skill, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
outfit: Robes, Bo, Wakizashi, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Part priests and part monks, the Asahina value preserving life over destruction, treat every ritual as a lesson and prize the making of art. Their magic leans towards protection.

techniques.name: The Soul’s Grace
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to reduce all opponents' damage rolls within 20' by 0k1 for a number of Rounds equal to School Rank (re-triggering resets but doesn't stack the duration); Free Raise on Defense-keyword spells.

name: Daidoji Iron Warrior [Bushi]
skills: Battle, Defense 2, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any one Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Crane's quiet strength: heavy infantry and yojimbo who win the day when words fail, with Techniques for enduring blows and guarding others.

techniques.name: The Force of Honor
techniques.text: Gain bonus Wounds per Wound Rank equal to (Honor Rank rounded down, minus 4, minimum 1); +1k0 to attack rolls in the Attack Stance.

techniques.name: The Shield of Faith
techniques.text: The Guard Maneuver lasts one extra Round and its Armor TN bonus increases by 5 (to both you and your target).

techniques.name: Strike Beneath the Veil
techniques.text: Melee attack as a Simple Action while in the Attack Stance.

techniques.name: Vigilance of Mind
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point in the Reactions Stage to gain +2k1 to attack/damage next Round against someone who struck you or your Guard target.

techniques.name: To Tread on the Sword
techniques.text: Spend two Void Points as a Free Action to redirect an action from your Guard target to yourself, plus a Free Action to move toward them.

name: Daidoji Scout [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Hunting (Traps), Kenjutsu, Knives, Kyujutsu (Yumi), Stealth (Sneaking), any 1 Bugei or Low Skill
outfit: Light or Ashigaru Armor, Rugged Clothing, Daisho, Bow, Knife, any 1 weapon, Trap-making Gear, Camouflage Face-paint, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: A Daidoji style of scouting, ambush and precise strikes at commanders and supply lines. Its scouts use traps and surprise, accepting some dishonour for the good of the Crane.

techniques.name: Surveying the Land
techniques.text: +1k0 on Stealth and Hunting rolls; improvised/rural traps deal +1k1 extra damage.

techniques.name: Scouring the Shadows
techniques.text: +2k0 to attack rolls against unaware opponents.

techniques.name: Weaken the Resistance
techniques.text: Ignore Reduction from armor or school techniques (not natural or magical Reduction); +1k0 damage against targets with no such Reduction.

techniques.name: Strike and Move
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with katana, wakizashi, knife, or bow; traps deal +2k1 extra damage.

techniques.name: Cunning of Daidoji
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action for a precision strike: Maneuvers cost 1 less Raise and a hit gains +1k1 damage; against an unaware foe, Raises aren't limited by Void.

name: Doji Courtier
skills: Calligraphy, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette (Courtesy), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Artisan or Perform skill
outfit: Extravagant Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The source of the Crane's mastery of court. The Doji School builds vast networks of allies through favours and obligations, with a curriculum broad enough to meet any need.

techniques.name: The Soul of Honor
techniques.text: Free Raise on Courtier, Sincerity, and Etiquette while Honor is 6.0+; a Contested Roll can learn what favor someone needs.

techniques.name: Speaking in Silence
techniques.text: Roll Courtier/Intelligence (TN 15) to covertly communicate simple ideas with other trained Doji Courtiers or high-Courtier Crane.

techniques.name: The Perfect Gift
techniques.text: Roll Courtier/Awareness (TN 20, Raises for better gifts) to produce a helpful gift/favor; a successful gift can grant a 1-point Devotion Ally at no XP cost.

techniques.name: Voice of Honor
techniques.text: A won Contested Roll forces an opponent in debate to concede their position conflicts with Bushido.

techniques.name: The Gift of the Lady
techniques.text: Gain 1 Tattoo; add Reflexes to Armor TN, and may use Reflexes instead of Strength to control a Grapple.

name: Doji Magistrate [Bushi]
skills: Defense, Horsemanship, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Knives (Jitte), Polearms, any High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon (or 2 Knives), Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Crane magistrates trained to fight with compassion, avoiding injury where they can and favouring weapons such as the jitte and sasumata that disarm or capture.

techniques.name: Temper Steel With Honor
techniques.text: Add your Air Ring to Armor TN (unless helpless/unaware); +1k0 attacking with jitte or sasumata.

techniques.name: Flowing Like Water
techniques.text: Use your opponent's Strength instead of your own when rolling to control a Grapple or Disarm.

techniques.name: Breath of the Law
techniques.text: A successful Grapple or Disarm also Dazes the target.

techniques.name: Flowing Like Air
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action unarmed or with jitte, sasumata, or a Samurai-keyword weapon.

techniques.name: The Willow in the Storm
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point in the Reactions Stage so attackers next Round subtract your Air Ring from each die (including exploding dice); not usable in Full Attack or Center Stance.

name: Kakita Bushi
skills: Etiquette, Iaijutsu (Focus), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Kakita Dueling Academy is devoted to iaijutsu above all. Its champions decide battles before they begin and answer any challenge at court.

techniques.name: The Way of the Crane
techniques.text: Add twice your Iaijutsu Skill to Initiative rolls; while in the Center Stance (and the Round after), gain +1k1 plus your School Rank to attack and Focus rolls.

techniques.name: Speed of Lightning
techniques.text: +2k0 to attack rolls against targets with lower Initiative than yours.

techniques.name: First and Last Strike
techniques.text: Strike first in a duel by winning the Iaijutsu/Void roll by 3+; gain a Free Raise per extra margin of 3 instead of 5.

techniques.name: One Strike Two Cuts
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Strike With No Thought
techniques.text: Take a Simple Action (including Move) each Turn while in Center Stance, gaining its benefits immediately and able to hold the stance indefinitely.

name: Kakita Artisan
skills: Courtier, Games: Sadane, Etiquette, Sincerity, any 3 skills from Acting/Artisan/Perform
outfit: Court Robes, Beautiful Clothing, Wakizashi, Art supplies, Fan, Steed (Rokugan pony), Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Kakita Artisan Academy studies every art, performed or crafted, and how each can serve the Crane Clan.

techniques.name: Soul of the Artisan
techniques.text: Choose a 'chosen art' Skill: +2k0 to its rolls, unlimited Raises; Free Raise when critiquing others' art with Games: Sadane.

techniques.name: The Soul’s Dream
techniques.text: A Contested Roll during a public performance can emotionally sway the audience for hours equal to your Insight Rank.

techniques.name: Free the Spirit
techniques.text: Choose a second 'chosen art'; the bonus for chosen arts rises to +2k1.

techniques.name: Undying Name
techniques.text: Roll (chosen art)/Awareness (TN 20 + 5x target's Glory) to raise or lower their Glory (or inflict Infamy with Raises); once per target per 6 months.

techniques.name: A Gift Beyond Price
techniques.text: Once per month, a Contested Roll gifting your art can permanently shift someone's attitude toward your clan, favorably on success.

name: Kitsuki Investigator [Courtier]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Investigation (Interrogation), Kenjutsu, Meditation, Sincerity, any one Lore Skill
outfit: Traditional Clothing, Wakizashi, Knife, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Alone in the Empire, the Kitsuki believe in evidence. Their School hones near-perfect memory and observation, making them the Dragon's courtiers and natural magistrates.

techniques.name: Kitsuki’s Method
techniques.text: Free Raise on all Investigation rolls; add your Perception to your Armor TN in a skirmish.

techniques.name: Wisdom the Wind Brings
techniques.text: Anyone lying to you, deceiving you socially, or using Feint/Disarm against you adds +5 to their TN per your School Rank.

techniques.name: Know the Rhythm of the Heart
techniques.text: After conversing briefly, roll Investigation (Notice)/Perception vs. their Intelligence x5 to accurately read their personality and motivations.

techniques.name: Finding the Path
techniques.text: A Contested Roll (Investigation (Interrogation)/Intelligence vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Intelligence) reveals one of a target's allies or enemies; each Raise reveals another. Usable once per target per day.

techniques.name: The Eyes Betray the Heart
techniques.text: Automatically win a Contested Roll (Investigation (Interrogation)/Perception vs. their Sincerity (Deceit)/Willpower) to detect any deliberate lie told to you; +5k0 if you already suspected the lie, and Raises can extract extra information.

name: Mirumoto Bushi
skills: Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Shugenja, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The only School that teaches Niten, fighting with katana and wakizashi together, which fuels a long rivalry with the Kakita's single-sword style.

techniques.name: Way of the Dragon
techniques.text: Wielding katana and wakizashi together (Niten) removes dual-wield penalties and adds your School Rank to Armor TN, stacking with the normal two-weapon bonus; you may also raise or lower the TN of a spell cast at you by 5.

techniques.name: The Calm in Midst of Thunder
techniques.text: While in the Center Stance, add your Kenjutsu Skill Rank to the total of your Iaijutsu rolls.

techniques.name: Strong and Swift
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Furious Retaliation
techniques.text: Choose an opponent who attacked you this Round; gain +3k0 to attack rolls against them on your next Turn.

techniques.name: Heart of the Dragon
techniques.text: Wielding katana and wakizashi and attacking twice in a Turn grants one additional off-hand attack as a Free Action.

name: Mirumoto Taoist Swordsman [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any 1 Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Sturdy Clothing, Katana, Wakizashi, Tanto, Traveling Pack, 1 koku
lore: Swordsmen who train beside the Togashi tattooed monks and bring their unconventional methods to the blade.

techniques.name: Aligned With the Elements
techniques.text: Wielding a sword while wearing no armor grants Reduction equal to School Rank + 2 and +1k0 to sword damage.

techniques.name: Fist and Blade
techniques.text: With a sword, perform Knockdown for 1 less Raise, and a controlled Grapple can deal the sword's damage instead of unarmed damage.

techniques.name: Strike of Harmony
techniques.text: You may spend a Void Point on damage while wielding any sword, stacking with the katana's own Void-spending ability if applicable.

techniques.name: Master of Steel
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action while wielding a sword.

techniques.name: Balance of Nothingness
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, spend unlimited Void Points on a single damage roll while wielding a sword.

name: Tamori Shugenja
skills: Athletics, Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Divination, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Formed from the Agasha who stayed with the Dragon, the Tamori inherited their experimental magic, notably sealing a spell's essence in prepared liquids for later use.

techniques.name: Flesh of the Elements
techniques.text: Store a person/creature-targeting spell in a potion by expending a spell slot; anyone can trigger it later by drinking (Simple Action) or throwing it (Complex Action, Athletics/Agility). It still counts against your daily spell slots each day it awaits use, and takes hours equal to the spell's Mastery Level to brew. Also grants a Free Raise on Craft-keyword spells.

name: The Togashi Tattooed Order [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Artisan: Tattooing, Defense, Jiujutsu, any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any one non-Low Skill
outfit: Robes, Bo, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The ise zumi, whose tattoos, inked with the Kami Togashi's blood, grant supernatural powers. Revered and feared, they excel at unarmed combat and feats of athleticism.

techniques.name: Blood of the Kami
techniques.text: Gain two Tattoos at this Rank.

techniques.name: Body of Stone
techniques.text: +1k1 to the total of all unarmed attack and damage rolls.

techniques.name: Blessing of the Kami
techniques.text: Gain two additional Tattoos.

techniques.name: Will of Stone
techniques.text: Unarmed attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Touch of the Kami
techniques.text: Gain two additional Tattoos.

name: The Hoshi Tsurui Zumi Order [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), any 2 Skills
outfit: Robes, Bo, Traveling Pack, 2 koku
lore: A branch of the Togashi tattooed monks begun in the Hidden Emperor era, when Togashi Hoshi broke with Hitomi and began tattooing his own followers.

techniques.name: Swift Fist, Subtle Heart
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to gain, for a number of Rounds equal to your School Rank, either +1k1 to unarmed attack rolls or +1k0 to unarmed damage (chosen each Turn). You begin with 1 Tattoo and 2 known Kiho (prerequisites still apply), can buy further Kiho as a Brotherhood of Shinsei monk, and gain an additional Tattoo at School Rank 4.

name: The Hitomi Kikage Zumi Order [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (choose one), Meditation, any 2 Non-Low Skills
outfit: Sturdy Clothing, Traveling Pack, 4 koku
lore: Tattooed monks, mostly of the Hitomi family, who seek enlightenment through violent physical action. They flourish under Lady Hitomi but appear in other eras too.

techniques.name: The Gift of the Lady
techniques.text: Gain 1 Tattoo; add Reflexes to Armor TN, and may use Reflexes instead of Strength to control a Grapple.

techniques.name: Strike the Base
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point on unarmed damage rolls, including damage inflicted in a Grapple.

techniques.name: Moving the Wind
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action when unarmed; gain one additional Tattoo.

techniques.name: Strike the Center
techniques.text: Perform Knockdown unarmed for 1 less Raise, and gain +1k1 to unarmed damage (including Grapple damage).

techniques.name: Strike the Summit
techniques.text: Knockdown attempts may call 2 additional Raises, automatically Stunning on a success; thrown Grapple targets must roll Earth (TN 20) or also be Stunned. Gain 1 additional Tattoo.

name: Akodo Bushi
skills: Battle (Mass Combat), Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: History, Sincerity, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The Akodo refuse narrow specialisation: their School perfects precise, fundamental kenjutsu and pairs it with a thorough study of battle.

techniques.name: The Way of the Lion
techniques.text: Choose to ignore an opponent's Armor-derived Armor TN, or gain a Free Raise when attacking; also +1k0 on your first melee attack against a foe each skirmish, or against anyone who's Raised on you since your last Turn (capped at +1k0 regardless of how many times).

techniques.name: Strength of Purity
techniques.text: Add your Honor Rank to the total of one roll per Turn during a skirmish (not damage rolls, and not while in the Center Stance).

techniques.name: Strength of My Ancestors
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Triumph Before Battle
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, designate an opponent during the Reactions Stage; ignore their Stance-based Armor TN bonus next Round.

techniques.name: Akodo’s Final Lesson
techniques.text: On a Bugei Skill Roll with Raises, if you meet the original TN but miss the Raised TN, you still succeed (just without the Raise benefits).

name: Ikoma Bard [Courtier]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History (Lion Clan), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High Skill, any one Bugei Skill
outfit: Traditional Clothing, Wakizashi, Knife, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The Empire's great storytellers. Ikoma bards argue through history and parable, invoking ancestors and heroes to win debates and spread Glory.

techniques.name: The Herald of Glory
techniques.text: Gain the Precise Memory Advantage free; publicly praising someone's heroic deeds via a successful Perform: Storytelling/Awareness roll (TN 20) grants them Glory equal to your School Rank, usable per person per month up to your School Rank times.

techniques.name: The Heart of the Lion
techniques.text: No Honor/Glory loss for displaying emotion publicly on behalf of a Lion or an honorable cause; Intimidation/Temptation against you add +5 to their TN per your School Rank.

techniques.name: The Voice of the Ancestors
techniques.text: Before a battle, inspire allies with Perform: Oratory/Awareness (TN 15 + 5 per person, +5 more per non-Lion target); success lets each inspired ally add their Honor Rank to one Skill Roll during that battle.

techniques.name: The Strength of Tradition
techniques.text: A number of times per session equal to School Rank, encourage an ally (Perform: Storytelling/Awareness, TN 25); on success, their next failed roll that day can be re-rolled with your Honor Rank in unkept dice added — but you lose 2 Honor if that re-roll also fails.

techniques.name: Every Lion is Your Brother
techniques.text: Five times per session, add unkept dice equal to your Perform: Storytelling Rank to a Contested Social Roll by citing historical precedent.

name: Ikoma Lion’s Shadow [Bushi]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Kenjutsu, Investigation (Notice), Sincerity, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
outfit: Traditional Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: A small, secretive School that keeps alive the ruthless, pragmatic methods of the first Ikoma, which the family's histories prefer to forget.

techniques.name: No Boundaries
techniques.text: No Honor loss for Low Skills used for the Lion Clan's benefit; as a Free Action, target a number of foes equal to School Rank for +1k0 on attack and Contested Rolls against them, usable School Rank times per day, lasting the rest of the day.

techniques.name: The Lion Cannot Fail
techniques.text: +1k0 on all School Skill Rolls.

techniques.name: The Spirit of Ikoma
techniques.text: Once per Round, lose 3 Honor as a Free Action for +2k1 to attack, damage, and Contested Social Skill Rolls until the end of the Round.

techniques.name: The Quiet Lion’s Claws
techniques.text: Melee weapon attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Ferocious Determination
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action for a Contested Roll (Courtier/Awareness vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness); winning subtracts your Awareness plus their Honor Rank from their attack and Contested Social rolls against you for hours equal to your School Rank. Doesn't work on targets without an Honor Rank.

name: Kitsu Shugenja
skills: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Keeping rituals unchanged since the family began, the Kitsu sense and work the bonds between the living, their ancestors and other realms, and command large-scale battle magic.

techniques.name: Eyes of the Ancestors
techniques.text: Roll a Spell Casting Roll (as a Water spell) vs. the target's Willpower x5 to learn all their Spiritual Advantages/Disadvantages; spend a Void Point to suppress one Spiritual Advantage of theirs for minutes equal to School Rank. Also grants a Free Raise on Battle-keyword spells.

name: Lion Elite Spearmen [Bushi]
skills: Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Lore: History, Polearms, Spears (Magari-Yari), any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Normal clothing, daisho, ten nage-yari, spear (magari-yari), any one other spear or polearm, light or ashigaru armor, traveling pack, 5 koku
lore: The Lion's spear units are few in modern times and other Clans see them as a relic of an earlier age. Several escort the new Miya Governor of Naishou Province.

techniques.name: The Way of Magari-Yarijutsu
techniques.text: +1k0 on Spear and Polearm Skill rolls; in Center, Defense, or Full Defense Stance with a spear/polearm, gain Reduction equal to half your Skill Rank.

techniques.name: Strike Like The Lion
techniques.text: With a spear or polearm, ignore enemy Reduction equal to half your Honor Rank (rounded up).

techniques.name: Strike Through the Eagle
techniques.text: Ready/draw a nage-yari as a Free Action any number of times per Round; nage-yari thrown attacks become a Simple Action.

techniques.name: Strike Like the Wind
techniques.text: Melee attacks become a Simple Action when wielding a spear or polearm.

techniques.name: Strike With the Soul
techniques.text: The Extra Attack Maneuver costs only 3 Raises with a spear/polearm in melee; thrown spear attacks may include one Free Action attack.

name: Matsu Beastmaster [Bushi]
skills: Animal Handling 2, Battle, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, any 1 Bugei Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 4 koku
lore: Matsu who take lion warcats into their own pride and communicate with them almost mystically, though the bond can leave them awkward among people.

techniques.name: One with the Pride
techniques.text: Gain a bonded lion warcat that follows commands and won't attack you; direct it to Attack (Complex Action) or it defaults to Guard.

techniques.name: Heart of the Beast
techniques.text: Gain a second warcat; you and your lions gain Swift 2 and an extra Wound Rank.

techniques.name: The Ferocity Within
techniques.text: Melee attacks become a Simple Action with katana, wakizashi, magari-yari, nage-yari, knives, or unarmed; direct a warcat to Attack as a Simple Action.

techniques.name: All as One
techniques.text: Pride members get two claw attacks per Round; you and your pride gain +2k1 on damage while fighting together; a directed warcat Attack may include a Simple Move Action.

techniques.name: With the Soul of a Lion
techniques.text: Gain a third warcat; all your warcats gain +10 Armor TN, +2 Reduction, and +2 Fear.

name: Matsu Berserker [Bushi]
skills: Battle, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: History, any two Bugei Skills
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Most Matsu train here. The School teaches total, fearless commitment to the attack, on the principle that a beaten foe cannot strike back.

techniques.name: The Lion’s Roar
techniques.text: Add your Honor Rank to all damage rolls; Full Attack Stance grants an extra 5' of movement (within your normal max).

techniques.name: Matsu’s Fury
techniques.text: In Full Attack Stance, a hit against a chosen target (within 30') freezes them from taking Move Actions unless they beat a Willpower roll (TN = damage dealt); immune to Fear-immune creatures.

techniques.name: The Lion’s Charge
techniques.text: Melee attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Matsu’s Courage
techniques.text: Ignore Wound Rank TN penalties up to your Honor Rank (double while in Full Attack Stance).

techniques.name: The Lion’s Victory
techniques.text: Once per encounter after rolling damage, spend a Void Point as a Free Action so all kept damage dice explode (reroll and add) instead of just 10s.

name: Agasha Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), any one Craft Skill, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Agasha shugenja pursue unconventional magic, from alchemy to spells that call on several elements at once, and the Phoenix let them take that study as far as it leads.

techniques.name: Elements of All Things
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to cast a spell using a different Ring than the one it normally requires (still uses a spell slot of the Ring actually used). Also grants a Free Raise on Craft-keyword spells.

name: Asako Henshin [Monk]
skills: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Lore: Elements, Lore: Theology, Meditation 2, any 1 Skill (not Low)
outfit: Robes, Bo, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: A secretive monastic sect of the Asako whose ways few outside the family understand. Its monks study how a person relates to the Elements that make up all things.

techniques.name: The Four Mysteries
techniques.text: As a Simple Action, raise or lower both Traits tied to one of your Rings by your School Rank (half, rounded down, minimum 1, if targeting someone else — and a Contested Willpower Roll if they're unwilling/unaware). Lasts minutes equal to your Insight Rank, usable up to 5x Insight Rank times per day. Doesn't change the underlying Ring or Wound Ranks.

techniques.name: The Riddle of Earth
techniques.text: As a Simple Action, become immune to all Conditional Effects (except Grappled and Mounted) for hours equal to your Earth Ring.

techniques.name: The Riddle of Air
techniques.text: As a Simple Action, see through all illusions and false images for hours equal to your School Rank; if an illusion comes from a spell above your Insight Rank, you must win a Contested Air Roll against the caster to see through it.

techniques.name: The Riddle of Fire
techniques.text: As a Complex Action, increase your kept dice on unarmed damage by your Fire Ring for a number of Rounds equal to your School Rank; alternatively, spend a Void Point when hit in melee to force a Contested Fire Roll that reduces the attacker's damage dice by your Fire Ring on a win.

techniques.name: The Riddle of Water
techniques.text: Succeed at Lore: Elements (Water)/Water (TN 20) to take one Complex and one Simple Action in a Turn, or three Simple Actions instead.

name: Asako Loremaster [Courtier]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, Sincerity, any Lore Skill
outfit: Sensible Clothing, Wakizashi, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Scholarly Asako courtiers who study an unusually wide range of subjects and turn that learning into insight and influence at court.

techniques.name: Temple of the Soul
techniques.text: Free Raise on any Lore Skill Roll; spending a Void Point on Etiquette grants +3k1 instead of the usual +1k1.

techniques.name: From the Ashes
techniques.text: After observing a court for a day, roll Lore: History/Perception (TN 20) for +2k0 on Social Skill Rolls for the next two days while you remain there (re-rollable to extend without further observation).

techniques.name: Voice of the Universe
techniques.text: Spend an hour conversing with an ally, then roll Lore: History/Intelligence (TN 25); success lets them add your Lore: History Rank to Social Skill Rolls for 24 hours (two Raises extends this to one more participating ally). Can't be reused on the same person until it expires.

techniques.name: Invincible Mind
techniques.text: When you fail a Contested Social Roll resisting emotional/social manipulation (not Fear), re-roll using Intelligence instead of the original Trait, keeping the second result.

techniques.name: Wisdom of the Ages
techniques.text: +5k0 on any Lore Skill Roll, including ones used for your other School Techniques.

name: Isawa Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Theology, any one Lore Skill, Medicine, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The oldest shugenja School in Rokugan and the largest shugenja family. The Isawa have pursued the secrets of the universe for more than a thousand years.

techniques.name: Isawa’s Gift
techniques.text: Free Raise on all Spell Casting Rolls of your Affinity element.

name: Shiba Artisan [Courtier]
skills: Artisan (pick 2), Calligraphy, Etiquette, Lore (pick 1), Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Sensible Clothing, Wakizashi, tools for chosen specialty, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: A quiet Shiba tradition that seeks to capture beauty as purely as possible; unlike the Kakita, a Shiba artist needs no audience.

techniques.name: Soul of Brilliance
techniques.text: Choose one Artisan Skill; spending a Void Point on it grants +2k2 instead of the usual +1k1.

techniques.name: The Way of Sincerity
techniques.text: Once per month, roll your chosen Artisan Skill (TN 15); the margin of success becomes XP usable only to buy the Allies Advantage, lasting weeks equal to your School Rank.

techniques.name: The Art Speaks
techniques.text: Choose one Artisan Skill; substitute its Rank for a called-for Social Skill on a roll (no Mastery Level benefits apply, since you don't actually have ranks in that Social Skill).

techniques.name: Bounty of the Craft
techniques.text: Once per day (15-minute ritual), roll your Artisan Skill (TN 30); on success, you and up to School Rank others present regain all Void Points. Doesn't work in the Shadowlands.

techniques.name: The Touch of Destiny
techniques.text: While your art is on display before others, everyone in the room gains 1 extra Void Point (you gain 2, and can deny the effect to anyone), capped at 1 per person per day (2 for you).

name: Shiba Bushi
skills: Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), Spears, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Warrior-scholars who look for any alternative to bloodshed, then strike swiftly when it comes. Their Techniques draw on the Void and protect others, suiting them to yojimbo work.

techniques.name: The Way of the Phoenix
techniques.text: Spending a Void Point for +1k1 can instead be upgraded to spending 2 Void Points for +2k2; Guard as a Free Action, though the target's Armor TN bonus drops to +5 instead of +10.

techniques.name: Dancing With the Elements
techniques.text: Choose a target within 30' each Round; you may raise or lower the TN of any spell they cast or are targeted by (by 5), and the same for spells targeting you directly.

techniques.name: One With the Void
techniques.text: Automatically regain a Void Point during the Reactions Stage whenever anyone else spends one this Round (even above your max, though excess is lost after combat); usable twice per skirmish.

techniques.name: Move With the World
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Polearms, Spears, or Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Touch of the Void
techniques.text: Each Void Point spent counts as two where applicable, and you may spend Void Points on enhancements twice in a single Turn.

name: Bayushi Bushi
skills: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: The School behind the Scorpion's villainous reputation trains its students as agents of discord, adding manipulation, stealth and even poison to their swordplay. Its Techniques are dirty tricks that exploit every advantage.

techniques.name: The Way of the Scorpion
techniques.text: +1k1 to Initiative Rolls; +5 Armor TN against any opponent with lower Initiative than you.

techniques.name: Pincers and Tail
techniques.text: The Feint Maneuver costs only 1 Raise instead of 2.

techniques.name: Strike at the Tail
techniques.text: Choose a target within 30' when you assume a Stance; a successful hit that Turn Fatigues them (as if they'd gone without rest for 24 hours) unless they beat an Earth Ring roll (TN 25) in the Reactions Stage.

techniques.name: Strike From Above Strike From Below
techniques.text: Melee attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: The Pincers Hold, The Tail Strikes
techniques.text: Once per encounter, spend a Void Point as a Complex Action for a melee attack that Stuns on a hit; the target can shake it off with an Earth Ring roll (TN = damage dealt) in the Reactions Stage.

name: Bayushi Courtier
skills: Calligraphy, Courtier (Gossip), Etiquette, Investigation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High skill
outfit: Extravagant Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Masters of manipulation whose patient gathering of secrets built the Scorpion's network of informants. They find the weakness in any opponent, or ally, and use it for the Clan.

techniques.name: Weakness is My Strength
techniques.text: In a Contested Social Roll, gain a Free Raise for every 3 points of Mental/Social Disadvantages your opponent has (max 5 Free Raises). Also, Free Raise on Courtier when spreading gossip, without needing a Raise to hide that you're the source.

techniques.name: Shallow Waters
techniques.text: After conversing briefly, win a Contested Roll (Investigation/Awareness vs. their Etiquette/Awareness) to learn their lowest-Rank Mental Trait and lowest-Rank Social Skill; spend a Void Point to also learn the next-lowest of each.

techniques.name: Secrets are Birthmarks
techniques.text: Win a Contested Roll (Courtier (Manipulation)/Awareness vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness) after conversing to force them to reveal one Mental or Social Advantage/Disadvantage (just its title, not details); a revealed Disadvantage lets you claim a free 2-point Blackmail Advantage on them (GM permitting).

techniques.name: Scrutiny’s Sweet Sting
techniques.text: Against someone you have Blackmail on, their dice can't explode on Contested Social Rolls against you; spend a Void Point on any Contested Social Roll to force the opponent to use a mental Trait of your choice.

techniques.name: No More Masks
techniques.text: A number of times per session equal to School Rank, win an Opposed Roll (Courtier (Gossip)/Awareness vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness, +5k0 if you have Blackmail on them) to inflict a Social Disadvantage, Sworn Enemy, or Obligation on the target for a month. Can't reuse on the same target until it expires.

name: Shosuro Actor [Ninja]
skills: Acting, Etiquette, Knives, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
outfit: Fine Clothing, Assorted Costumes and Disguises, Knife, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Shinobi who infiltrate in plain sight, disguised as servants, peasants or even particular samurai, which is why the Shosuro have long practised acting.

techniques.name: The First Face
techniques.text: Learn one persona; spending a Void Point on Acting or Sincerity (Deceit) grants +3k1 instead of the usual +1k1.

techniques.name: The Subtle Sting
techniques.text: +2k0 to attack rolls when wielding a Small weapon.

techniques.name: The Second Face
techniques.text: Learn a second persona; may spend 2 Void Points (instead of 1) when enhancing a School Skill Roll, stacking with Rank 1's bonus.

techniques.name: The Viper’s Kiss
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action instead of Complex when using a Small-sized weapon.

techniques.name: The Third Face
techniques.text: Learn a third persona; Raises aren't limited by Void when attacking an unaware or unsuspecting foe.

name: Shosuro Infiltrator [Ninja]
skills: Acting, Athletics, Ninjutsu, Sincerity, Stealth (Sneaking) 2, any one Skill
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Black Clothing, Daisho, Bow or Knife, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: A School few outsiders know exists, training silent killers who strike unsuspecting targets from hiding, without pleasure or remorse.

techniques.name: The Path of Shadows
techniques.text: No Honor loss for Low Skills or Ninjutsu weapons used for the Scorpion Clan; +2k0 to all Stealth Skill rolls.

techniques.name: Strike From Darkness
techniques.text: Attacking someone unaware of you removes the Void limit on Raises and adds unkept dice equal to School Rank to the attack roll; against a Condition-afflicted foe (like Stunned/Fatigued) add half that many unkept dice instead — the two don't stack, choose one.

techniques.name: Steel Within Silk
techniques.text: Attack (melee, or ranged with shuriken/tsubute) as a Simple Action instead of Complex when ambushing or using Ninjutsu/Ninja-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Whisper of Steel
techniques.text: After attacking (only if you make just one attack that Round), opponents/bystanders need a Contested Roll (Investigation (Notice)/Perception vs. your Stealth/Agility) to even detect you.

techniques.name: The Final Silence
techniques.text: After a successful damage roll, spend Void Points (any number) to bump up to two damage dice each to 10 (non-exploding).

name: Soshi Magistrate [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Intimidation (Control), Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Underworld, any Bugei Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Grown from techniques taught to the yoriki of Soshi Saibankan, this School trains the Scorpion's magistrates and guards in both armed and unarmed fighting.

techniques.name: The Face of Justice
techniques.text: +1k0 to Intimidation (+2k0 vs. someone of lower Status); +1k0 damage on melee attacks.

techniques.name: Rise to Meet the Challenge
techniques.text: While Prone, a Free Action Athletics/Agility roll (TN 20) lets you stand back up; +1k1 to rolls controlling a Grapple.

techniques.name: The Magistrate’s Cut
techniques.text: Once per opponent per skirmish, a melee Called Shot with 3 Raises temporarily Blinds the target until the Reactions Stage of the next Round.

techniques.name: Certainty of Purpose
techniques.text: Melee attacks (including unarmed) become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Relentless Resolve
techniques.text: Once per skirmish (not in Center Stance), gain unkept dice equal to your Intimidation Rank on all attack rolls for one Round.

name: Soshi Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 5 koku
lore: Called in when stealth and subtlety are needed, Soshi shugenja coax the amoral kami into trickery and can cast most non-damaging spells without any visible sign.

techniques.name: The Kami’s Whisper
techniques.text: Sacrifice an extra spell slot of the same Element when casting a non-damaging spell to hide all visible signs it was cast; also grants a Free Raise on Illusion-keyword spells.

name: Yogo Wardmaster [Shugenja]
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, pack of twenty paper wards, 3 koku
lore: Shugenja of the Yogo's closely guarded ward magic: protective charms more flexible than the Toritaka's exorcism wards.

techniques.name: Way of the Wardmaster
techniques.text: Cast a Wards-keyword spell with extra Raises (equal to its Mastery Level) to store it latent in a paper ward; activate it later as a Simple Action by placing it on a target (an unwilling target requires a Spellcraft/Agility attack roll). Destroying an active ward ends its effect; the spell slot isn't freed until the ward discharges or is destroyed unused.

name: Horiuchi Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Craft: Meishodo, Defense, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft (Spell Research), any 1 High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll/Amulet Satchel, Traveling Pack, 4 koku
lore: Keepers of meishodo, the talisman magic the Unicorn gathered from many peoples on their travels beyond the Empire. In earlier eras the Iuchi teach it.

techniques.name: Mysteries of Meishodo
techniques.text: Craft magical amulets: roll Craft: Meishodo/Ring for the spell's Ring (TN 15 + 5x Mastery Level, taking hours equal to the Mastery Level) to store one spell in a charm. Casting from it takes one Complex Action with no Spell Casting Roll needed (and no Raise benefits), still using a spell slot. Only spells of Mastery Level up to your School Rank (never 4-6) can be stored this way, and anyone trained in meishodo can use your amulets.

name: Ide Emissary [Courtier]
skills: Calligraphy, Commerce, Courtier, Etiquette (Conversation), Horsemanship, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High or Perform skill
outfit: Extravagant Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The most peaceable courtiers of the Great Clans, the Ide cultivate calm and mediation. Their Techniques never attack; they defuse conflict and protect the Emissary.

techniques.name: The Heart Speaks
techniques.text: Roll Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness (TN 20) to avoid inadvertently giving offense; Free Raise on Sincerity (Honesty), but Sincerity (Deceit) rolls get +5 TN instead.

techniques.name: Piercing the Veils
techniques.text: Win a Contested Roll (Etiquette/Awareness vs. their Etiquette/Willpower) to get a general sense of someone's true feelings in a social situation; Raises reveal more specific insight.

techniques.name: The Heart Listens
techniques.text: After at least 10 minutes of conversation, win a Contested Roll (Sincerity (Honesty)/Awareness vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Willpower) to shift their attitude toward you positively; two Raises makes them a temporary Ally for the day. Doesn't work on Sworn Enemies.

techniques.name: Answering the Heart
techniques.text: Add unkept dice equal to your School Rank when using your Rank 2 and Rank 3 techniques.

techniques.name: The Immovable Hand of Peace
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to win a Contested Roll (Sincerity (Honesty)/Awareness vs. their Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness); on success, the target can't take hostile action against you for hours equal to twice your School Rank, as long as you don't act hostile toward them either. Doesn't work on targets with Honor Rank below 2.0 or no Honor Rank.

name: Iuchi Shugenja
skills: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Horsemanship, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Extravagant clothing, wakizashi, Scroll Satchel, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, Horse, 10 koku
lore: Free-spirited and unconventional, the Iuchi learned much of their craft on the open plains during the Unicorn's wanderings, meishodo talismans included. Their magic favours speed and travel.

techniques.name: Spirit of the Wind
techniques.text: As a Complex Action, sacrifice a spell slot of any element to grant a target an extra Simple Move Action on their next Turn (lost if unused). Also grants a Free Raise on Travel-keyword spells.

name: Moto Bushi
skills: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Scimitar), any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill
outfit: Riding or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, Horse, 10 koku, any one weapon
lore: Descended in part from the nomads who joined the Unicorn abroad, the Moto fight as unrestrained heavy cavalry, a style other Clans find both fearsome and improper.

techniques.name: The Way of the Unicorn
techniques.text: Wield any two-handed weapon (except bows) in one hand; +1k0 damage while mounted, using a scimitar, or using a two-handed melee weapon (these don't stack); scimitars count as having the Samurai keyword for you.

techniques.name: Shinsei’s Smile
techniques.text: Gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to half your opponent's current Wound Rank TN penalty (rounded down).

techniques.name: Desert Wind Strike
techniques.text: Melee weapon attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: The Charge of Madness
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, if you drop a target to the Out Wound Level, immediately make one more attack as a Free Action against a different target (no Raises allowed).

techniques.name: Moto Cannot Yield
techniques.text: While mounted or in Full Attack Stance with a two-handed or Samurai-keyword weapon, keep extra damage dice equal to half your Strength (rounded down).

name: Moto Death Priest [Shugenja]
skills: Athletics, Horsemanship, Hunting, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any 1 Skill
outfit: Sturdy Traveling Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, Horse, 5 koku
lore: Followers of the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang, a wrathful pantheon of foreign death gods, who turn those gods' disfavour on their enemies.

techniques.name: Blessings of the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang
techniques.text: As a Simple Action, sacrifice a spell slot to target an enemy within School Rank x100 feet with a Contested Willpower Roll; on success they can't benefit from exploding dice or re-roll Advantages for Rounds equal to your School Rank. Also grants a Free Raise on Travel-keyword spells.

name: Moto Vindicator [Bushi]
skills: Horsemanship, Hunting, Investigation (Notice), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any 1 Bugei Skill
outfit: Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 Weapon, Traveling Pack, Riding Horse, 5 koku
lore: Born of the shame of Moto Tsume's fall into the Shadowlands, the Vindicators swore to destroy the Tainted Moto and every Shadowlands creature.

techniques.name: Purity of the Breath
techniques.text: Each Round, choose either to reduce Wound Rank TN penalties, or add to your Armor TN, by School Rank + Willpower (doubled against Shadowlands creatures).

techniques.name: Facing the Dark Within
techniques.text: +2k0 on all Investigation rolls (+2k1 specifically to notice Shadowlands Taint).

techniques.name: Justice of Our Ancestors
techniques.text: Melee attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Avenging Our Own
techniques.text: +2k0 to attack and damage rolls against an enemy who's attacked you this skirmish, or against any Tainted creature regardless.

techniques.name: Bloodied but Unbowed
techniques.text: Once per skirmish (Free Action), for two Rounds add your current Wound Rank TN penalty to melee damage rolls (extendable a third Round by taking 10 Wounds).

name: Shinjo Bushi
skills: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any 1 Skill
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Bow, Knife, Traveling Pack, Horse, 10 koku
lore: Mounted fighters whose style adopts foreign methods from the Unicorn's travels, such as the active parry and riposte, unfamiliar to most Rokugani.

techniques.name: The Way of the Ki-Rin
techniques.text: When spending a Void Point for +1k1 on a School Skill Roll, also add your Horsemanship Rank to the total (not usable in Center Stance).

techniques.name: Dance of the Blade
techniques.text: In Full Defense Stance, when hit by an attack, take a Free Action to win a Contested Agility Roll and turn the attack into a miss instead; usable School Rank times per Round.

techniques.name: The Four Winds Strike
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Samurai-keyword weapons; while mounted, also with a bow.

techniques.name: Spirit of the Blade Unleashed
techniques.text: In Defense or Full Defense Stance, after an opponent's melee attack resolves against you, take a Free Action for a melee counterattack (shifting you into Attack Stance); usable School Rank times per skirmish, once per Round.

techniques.name: Dancing With the Fortunes
techniques.text: While mounted, instead of spending a Void Point, roll a Void Ring Roll (TN 20, or 30 on foot) as a Free Action; success grants the Void Point's effect without spending it. Usable up to your starting Void Points per skirmish.

name: Utaku Battle Maiden [Bushi]
skills: Battle, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Light or Riding Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, Horse, 10 koku
lore: The shiotome, the most respected cavalry in the Empire and the only riders allowed to breed the Utaku steeds. Honor strengthens their mounted Techniques.

techniques.name: Riding in Harmony
techniques.text: Add your Honor Rank to one attack roll per Round (or a damage roll instead, while mounted); +Honor Rank to all Horsemanship rolls.

techniques.name: The Void of War
techniques.text: During Stage 1 of a Combat Round, add +5 to either Initiative Score or Armor TN (lasts until you use this again or the skirmish ends).

techniques.name: Sensing the Breeze
techniques.text: While mounted, attacks become a Simple Action instead of Complex.

techniques.name: Wind Never Stops
techniques.text: While mounted, spend a Void Point to charge as a Simple Action (move + attack together, at your steed's speed); a successful hit grants +2k1 to all damage rolls that Turn.

techniques.name: Otaku’s Blessing
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action at the start of your Turn to add your Honor Rank to all damage rolls and Bugei Skill Rolls that Turn (stacks with Riding in Harmony).

name: Utaku Mounted Infantry [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Polearms, Spears, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Normal clothing, daisho, any one spear or polearm, light armor, steed, traveling pack, 5 koku
lore: Soldiers who ride to battle and fight on foot, developed during the Unicorn's wanderings; many are Otaku men barred by tradition from fighting on horseback.

techniques.name: Choose Your Weapon
techniques.text: Choose Kenjutsu, Polearms, or Spears; gain a free Emphasis in it and +1k0 to attack rolls with it. In Defense/Full Defense Stance with that weapon, add full Skill Rank to Armor TN (Spears/Polearms) or half Skill Rank rounded down (Kenjutsu).

techniques.name: Speed of My Sisters
techniques.text: On foot, move as if your Water Ring were 1 Rank higher; +1k0 to Initiative rolls.

techniques.name: All-Fronts Attack
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with your chosen weapon Skill.

techniques.name: Utaku’s Thunder
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, spend a Void Point to add your Honor Rank in unkept dice to an attack roll with your chosen weapon; your Rank 2 movement bonus improves to Water Rank +2.

techniques.name: Epic of My Name
techniques.text: Your Rank 1 Armor TN bonus now also applies in Attack Stance; once per skirmish in Full Attack Stance (or Attack Stance too, for Spears/Polearms), add +4k2 to a damage roll with your chosen weapon.

name: Chuda Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Hunting, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, Stealth, any one Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Heirs of the destroyed Snake Clan, the Chuda keep a secret tradition of maho centuries old and now serve the Spider, always pushing blood magic further whatever it costs.

techniques.name: Blood Like Water
techniques.text: Declare a Raise when casting maho to hide its corrupted nature; a second Raise (or 1 Honor) caps the Taint gained from that spell at 1 point.

name: Daigotsu Bushi
skills: Hunting, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei or Low Skill
outfit: Light Armour, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Spider Clan warriors whose style is pieced together from the Schools they knew in their former lives. Eclectic but brutal, it can even feed on a dying foe's life force.

techniques.name: The Way of the Spider
techniques.text: Each Round, choose to reduce Wound-Rank TN penalties or increase damage rolls by Strength + Taint Rank; detecting your Taint is also harder (TN +10).

techniques.name: Aura of Blood
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to grant yourself and nearby allies +2k0 to damage rolls for a duration based on Taint + Strength.

techniques.name: Ashura’s Wing
techniques.text: Melee attack as a Simple Action.

techniques.name: Devouring Wrath
techniques.text: Regain 5 Wounds whenever you hit an opponent in melee (up to a small cap beyond your max, lost after the skirmish).

techniques.name: Inhuman Assault
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, a Complex-Action attack that ignores armor/Stance bonuses; on a hit, the target loses those bonuses for several rounds.

name: Daigotsu Courtier
skills: Acting, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High Skill
outfit: Sensible Clothing, Wakizashi, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Spider courtiers who slip into the courts of the Great Clans in disguise, using blackmail and contacts to steer rivals into conflict while hiding their own Taint.

techniques.name: Insidious Whispers
techniques.text: Free Raise on Sincerity (Deceit); Taint-detection TN vs. you rises with your School Rank, and your School Rank adds to your effective Honor when others judge it.

techniques.name: Cracks in the Wall
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point and roll Courtier/Awareness (TN 25) to penalize everyone nearby's Etiquette/Perform rolls for an hour, without them knowing why.

techniques.name: Darkness Cannot be Trapped
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to shift blame for an accusation onto someone else present, via a Contested Roll.

techniques.name: The Touch of Sin
techniques.text: A number of times per session equal to your School Rank, a Contested Roll can inflict a Consumed by Shourido Disadvantage on a target temporarily.

techniques.name: The Embrace of Darkness
techniques.text: A Contested Roll can convince a target to treat someone else as an enemy (not their lord or the Emperor); easier if they're already Consumed by Shourido.

name: Goju Ninja
skills: Athletics, Kenjutsu, Ninjutsu, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth 2, any one Skill
outfit: Black Clothing, Ninja-to, Tanto, 6 Shuriken or Tsubute, any one weapon, 50 feet of Rope and Grapple, Traveling Pack, 1 koku
lore: The faceless servants of the Lying Darkness, people whose identities the Nothing has consumed. They draw on it for infiltration, deception and murder.

techniques.name: The Cloak of Night
techniques.text: Simple Action to raise Armor TN by up to School Rank x5, at the cost of the same penalty to most other rolls, for the skirmish.

techniques.name: Melting into Shadow
techniques.text: Bonus rolled dice on Stealth equal to School Rank; detection TN against you rises by School Rank x5; Free Raise attacking unaware foes.

techniques.name: The Shadowed Blade
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with knives/Ninjutsu weapons, or make multiple shuriken attacks as a Complex Action equal to School Rank.

techniques.name: Step Within Shadow
techniques.text: Move between suitably-sized shadows as a Simple Move Action, range School Rank x100 feet.

techniques.name: Shadow upon the Moon
techniques.text: In darkness, dissolve into incorporeal vapor (immune to most harm except crystal), move freely but can't interact physically; gain +5 Initiative the first Round after reforming.

name: Ninube Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Knives, Sincerity (Lying), Spellcraft, Stealth 2, any Low skill
outfit: Black Clothing, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 2 Koku
lore: Called shugenja only for convenience, the Ninube are no longer truly individuals; their power, like the Goju's, comes from the Nothing.

techniques.name: Mask of the Nothing
techniques.text: Expend a spell slot to become an invisible-in-darkness shadow with a Stealth bonus, immune to most mundane harm; returning to physical form after lethal damage leaves you Stunned but alive.

name: The Order of the Spider Monks [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Polearms, any one Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armour, Sturdy Clothing, any Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Begun with the fallen monk Roshungi and spread by his student Michio, the Order teaches each follower to find their own path whatever it costs others.

techniques.name: The Dark Path
techniques.text: +1k0 to unarmed/polearm attack rolls, and add twice your School Rank to Armor TN against melee attacks.

techniques.name: Drawing in the Strike
techniques.text: Choose a non-Void Ring; gain Reduction equal to it, plus your Taint Rank if any.

techniques.name: Speed of Darkness
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action unarmed or with a polearm.

techniques.name: Guarded by Chi
techniques.text: Choose a non-Void Ring; add twice its value (plus Taint Rank) to the TN of spells cast against you, suppressible at will.

techniques.name: Darkness Unleashed
techniques.text: Gain extra daily Void Points equal to your Taint Rank or Earth Ring (whichever is higher), usable normally or for +1k1 damage.

name: Miya Herald [Courtier]
skills: Courtier (Rhetoric), Defense, Etiquette (Courtesy), Horsemanship, Lore: Heraldry, Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei skill
outfit: Sensible Clothing, Wakizashi, Calligraphy Set, Horse (Rokugani pony), 10 koku
lore: Imperial messengers who carry the Emperor's word to every corner of Rokugan. They build trust, calm disputes and can defend themselves on dangerous roads.

techniques.name: Voice of the Emperor
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point for the Way of the Land Advantage in your current province until you next sleep; attackers who revere the Emperor lose Honor equal to twice your School Rank.

techniques.name: Eyes of the Emperor
techniques.text: Add your Honor Rank to Etiquette (Courtesy) rolls resisting others' influence.

techniques.name: Hand of the Emperor
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to prevent Emperor-revering Rokugani from harming you until the next Reactions Step, outside of skirmishes/duels.

techniques.name: Blessing of the Emperor
techniques.text: A number of times per session equal to your School Rank, a Contested Roll can force honorable onlookers to cease violence for a minute.

techniques.name: Glory of the Emperor
techniques.text: +5k0 on Courtier or Etiquette rolls against targets with Honor 1.0+.

name: Otomo Courtier
skills: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Investigation, Sincerity, any 1 High Skill
outfit: Traditional Clothing, Wakizashi, Knife, Calligraphy Set, 10 Koku
lore: Imperial courtiers who protect the throne by sowing suspicion among the Great Clans. They trade on Imperial authority and use every underhanded trick, safe behind their bloodline.

techniques.name: The Voice of Heaven
techniques.text: No Honor loss for Intimidation (Control); a Contested Roll can provoke an argument between two other people.

techniques.name: Destiny Has No Secrets
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to roll Courtier/Awareness (TN 25) and learn one useful piece of GM-chosen information.

techniques.name: My Master’s Voice
techniques.text: A Contested Roll (Complex Action) can freeze an honorable target from acting against you or your allies for their next Turn.

techniques.name: The Emperor’s Protection
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point in an argument; winning a Contested Roll forces the target to agree or lose 5 Honor.

techniques.name: The Virtues of Command
techniques.text: +5k0 on Contested Social Rolls against those who revere Imperial authority.

name: Seppun Guardsman [Bushi]
skills: Battle, Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any 1 High Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 Weapon, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Miharu, who give up everything to guard the Imperial House. Their School puts defence, and the life of the one they protect, above the guardsman's own.

techniques.name: Never in Darkness
techniques.text: Extra unkept dice equal to School Rank resisting Temptation/Intimidation/Courtier meant to pull you from duty; +1k1 to Investigation rolls detecting ambushes.

techniques.name: The Clouds Part
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point at the start of your Turn to add Honor Rank to attack and damage rolls until your next Turn.

techniques.name: Sun’s Light Reveals
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point (or none near the Emperor) to roll Investigation/Perception (TN 25) and see through all disguises/illusions around you.

techniques.name: Speed of Heaven
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with Samurai-keyword weapons.

techniques.name: Heaven Never Falls
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to intercept an attack meant for someone you're guarding within 20', taking the damage yourself; if still standing, gain an extra Simple Action.

name: Seppun Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Meditation, Lore: Theology, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Bo, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Hidden Guard: shugenja who keep constant watch against threats steel cannot answer, with some of the finest wards in Rokugan, as the Emperor's last line of defence.

techniques.name: In Defense of the Throne
techniques.text: Free Raise on spells protecting the Emperor or Imperial family (when it wouldn't cost Honor), and on spells known only to Imperial families.

name: Ichiro Bushi
skills: Athletics, Commerce, Defense, Heavy Weapons, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), any High or Bugei skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any Heavy or Polearm, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Founded by a Hida, the Badger's School stays close to its Crab roots: wrestling, unarmed fighting and sheer strength that answers finesse with overwhelming force.

techniques.name: Transcend the Mountain
techniques.text: You may re-roll any Skill or Trait roll that uses Strength, but the second result stands. Moderate terrain costs you nothing on movement or combat, and Difficult terrain only half its usual penalty. (Core Rulebook p.216)

techniques.name: Strength of the Badger
techniques.text: As many times per session as your Strength, re-roll a damage roll and take the higher result. (Core Rulebook p.216)

techniques.name: Crushing Blow
techniques.text: Your attacks ignore the part of an opponent’s Armor TN that comes from armor, and your unarmed attacks ignore 1 Rank of the target’s Reduction. (Core Rulebook p.216)

techniques.name: Crashing Stones
techniques.text: Unarmed attacks, and attacks with Samurai weapons, are Simple Actions for you. (Core Rulebook p.216)

techniques.name: Return the Strike
techniques.text: When a skirmish begins, before anyone rolls Initiative, you may take -20 to your Initiative for the whole skirmish; in return, for the first two Rounds, roll extra unkept dice equal to your Strength on both attack and damage rolls. (Core Rulebook p.216)

name: Komori Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Ancestors, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, Tea Ceremony, any one High Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: The Bat Clan's shugenja draw on the koumori, kindly bat spirits of Chikushudo, for strange spells and swift messages across the Empire.

techniques.name: The Kami’s Whispers
techniques.text: Spend one spell slot to whisper a message to someone you know: up to thirty seconds long per School Rank, carried up to 100 miles per School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.217)

name: Heichi Bushi
skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Spears (Mai Chong), any one Bugei Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any Spear, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Shaped by the dangers of the Boar lands, Heichi bushi take the enemy's worst and keep fighting. The School favours the rare curved Mai Chong spear and a patient, defensive style.

techniques.name: The Charge of the Boar
techniques.text: While in the Full Attack Stance, readying a Medium weapon or a spear is a Free Action for you, and a spear you fight with gains +0k1 damage. (Core Rulebook p.218)

techniques.name: The Strength of Opposition
techniques.text: Entangling an opponent costs you two Raises with a mai chong, or three with any other spear. (Core Rulebook p.218)

techniques.name: The Speed of the Boar
techniques.text: Attacking with a spear is a Simple Action for you. (Core Rulebook p.218)

techniques.name: The Anger of the Boar
techniques.text: In the Reactions segment you may spend a Void Point to lower your Wound penalty by one Wound Rank for the rest of the skirmish; the Wounds themselves remain. (Core Rulebook p.218)

techniques.name: Beyond the Mountains
techniques.text: In the Full Defense Stance you may still make one ordinary attack with a spear or a Samurai weapon as a Free Action, at +2k0 to the attack roll. (Core Rulebook p.218)

name: Tonbo Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Courtier, Etiquette, Meditation (Void Recovery), Sincerity, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Deeply spiritual priests of the mountains who also serve as go-betweens for the Dragon at court, using their bond with the spirits to sharpen their social graces.

techniques.name: Guided by Fate
techniques.text: Spend a spell slot for +1k0 on a Social Skill Roll, never more slots on one roll than your School Rank. Free Raise on spells with the Divination keyword. (Core Rulebook p.218)

name: Toritaka Bushi
skills: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.

techniques.name: The Falcon’s Eyes
techniques.text: +1k0 on Perception-based Skill and Trait rolls, and +1k0 to damage against creatures from other Spirit Realms.

techniques.name: The Falcon Takes Flight
techniques.text: Roll Perception vs. TN equal to a nearby other-realm creature's Air Ring x5 to detect its presence.

techniques.name: The Falcon’s Wings
techniques.text: Attack as a Simple Action with a spear or Samurai-keyword weapon.

techniques.name: Vigilant and Strong
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to negate darkness/blinding penalties for about two Rounds.

techniques.name: Claws of the Falcon
techniques.text: Ignore up to 5 points of an opponent's Reduction; spend a Void Point as a Free Action to reduce a Spirit-Realm creature's Reduction by 10 for a Round.

name: Kitsune Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Hunting, Medicine (Herbalism), Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Living beside one of Rokugan's great forests, Fox shugenja learn to love its spirits and creatures, and their School deepens the bond between people and animals.

techniques.name: Essence of Chikushudo
techniques.text: Your Sense, Commune and Summon can reach Chikushudo’s animal spirits, not only the kami (Summon then brings one animal spirit rather than an amount of an element). Free Raise on any spell cast on an animal that does no damage. (Core Rulebook p.220)

name: Usagi Bushi
skills: Athletics (Running), Defense, Hunting, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Maho, any one High or Bugei skill
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Bow (with 20 arrows) or Knife, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Tested by centuries of war, the Hare's School turns their athleticism into hit-and-run attacks that seem to come from every side.

techniques.name: Speed of the Hare
