techniques.text: Where there is room to dodge and leap (the GM decides), add your Athletics Rank to your Armor TN, except in the Full Attack or Center Stance. For the distance of Move Actions your Water counts as 1 higher. (Core Rulebook p.221)

techniques.name: Leap of the Hare
techniques.text: In the Full Attack Stance you may spring at an opponent up to 15 feet away and attack without a Move Action; every attack you make that Turn must be against that opponent. (Core Rulebook p.221)

techniques.name: Swift as Lightning
techniques.text: Unarmed, knife and Samurai-weapon attacks are Simple Actions for you. (Core Rulebook p.221)

techniques.name: Kick of the Hare
techniques.text: Your Rank 2 leap now works in the Attack Stance too. Used in the Full Attack Stance, your second attack that Round may go to a different opponent within 15 feet of the first. (Core Rulebook p.221)

techniques.name: Reichin’s Style
techniques.text: A Feint costs you only 1 Raise, and the extra damage of a successful Feint is not capped at your Insight Rank x5. (Core Rulebook p.221)

name: Mantis Brawler [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Commerce, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Knives, Sailing, any 1 Weapon Skill
outfit: Rugged Clothing, any 2 weapons, Kama, Tanto, Traveling Pack, 4 koku
lore: Born of shipboard fights and tavern brawls among the Mantis Clan's pirates and smugglers, a fighting style even less conventional than the Yoritomo's.

techniques.name: Way of Drunken Fists
techniques.text: Being Prone costs you nothing on Armor TN, or on attacks with Small weapons or unarmed, and against ranged attacks you still get the usual Prone bonus to Armor TN. +1k0 on rolls to take control of a Grapple, and on damage dealt unarmed or with an improvised or Small weapon. (The Great Clans p.166)

techniques.name: Drunk Loses His Sandal
techniques.text: After a successful Feint you may give up 5 of its extra damage for +5 Armor TN until your next Turn (+10 if you Feinted while Prone). Once any enemy attack against you resolves, hit or miss, you may drop Prone as a Free Action. (The Great Clans p.166)

techniques.name: Drunk Never Falls
techniques.text: In a skirmish you ignore the penalties for being Fatigued, Dazed or drunk. While Stunned you can still take one Simple Action each Round. (The Great Clans p.166)

techniques.name: Two Drunks Dance
techniques.text: Unarmed, improvised-weapon and Small-weapon attacks are Simple Actions for you. (The Great Clans p.167)

techniques.name: Drunk Pounds a Door
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point on a melee attack for +4k1 to both its attack and damage rolls, or +4k2 if you are Prone. (The Great Clans p.167)

name: Moshi Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Divination, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any two High or Bugei Skills
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Long devoted to the Sun Goddess, the Moshi turned to practical weather magic after joining the Mantis and often sail on Yoritomo ships to calm the seas.

techniques.name: Favor of the Sun
techniques.text: By day you have a second Affinity, for Fire spells; it lapses at night. Free Raise on spells with the Thunder keyword. (Core Rulebook p.121)

name: Tsuruchi Archer [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation, Kyujutsu (Yumi) 2, any one Bugei or High Skill
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Bow and 20 arrows, Wakizashi, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Empire's finest archers since their days as the Wasp Clan, devoted to the purity of the bow: deadly at range, outclassed in melee.

techniques.name: Always Be Ready
techniques.text: +1k0 to the total of your attack rolls with a bow, and +3 to your Initiative Score. (Core Rulebook p.122)

techniques.name: The Arrow Knows the Way
techniques.text: A Free Raise usable only for the Called Shot Maneuver, and +2k0 to the total of damage rolls with a bow. (Core Rulebook p.122)

techniques.name: The Wasp’s Sting
techniques.text: Bow attacks are Simple Actions for you. (Core Rulebook p.122)

techniques.name: Flight of No-Mind
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, spend a Void Point and a Complex Action on one arrow that ignores armor entirely, and any Wound or visibility penalties. You may call Raises, but not Extra Attack, and the target must be within the bow’s normal range. (Core Rulebook p.122)

techniques.name: Tsuruchi’s Eye
techniques.text: A ranged attack made as a Complex Action gains +4k1 to both its attack and damage totals. Cannot be combined with Flight of No-Mind. (Core Rulebook p.122)

name: Tsuruchi Bounty Hunter [Bushi]
skills: Athletics, Hunting (Tracking), Intimidation, Investigation, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Underworld
outfit: Ashigaru or Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Bow or Knife, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: The Wasp Clan once lived by hunting fugitives for the Emerald Champion; a few Tsuruchi still learn that relentless trade as a School of its own.

techniques.name: A Hunter’s Sense
techniques.text: +1k1 on Intimidation against someone of lower caste you think can lead you to your quarry; with samurai the bonus falls to +1k0 but covers every Social Skill Roll. While hunting a particular target, roll extra unkept dice, as many as your School Rank, on Hunting or Investigation rolls to track it down. (The Great Clans p.168)

techniques.name: No Prey Escapes
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point to pass a Lore: Underworld roll automatically, naming criminals nearby who might tell you about your quarry. Dealing with them still costs Honor as usual. (The Great Clans p.168)

techniques.name: Justice of the Wasp
techniques.text: Against someone an Imperial authority (or a higher Mantis one) has found guilty of a crime, Disarm and Knockdown cost you one Raise fewer, and a successful one leaves the target Dazed. (The Great Clans p.168)

techniques.name: Twin Sting Strike
techniques.text: Ranged attacks with a yumi are Simple Actions for you; against a target so condemned (see Rank 3), so are melee attacks with a katana or any knife. (The Great Clans p.168)

techniques.name: Eyes of the Wasp
techniques.text: Identifying a samurai with Lore: Heraldry tells you their Honor Rank and every Social and Mental Disadvantage, as well as their Glory. Any opponent your Rank 3 Technique applies to is Dazed whenever you hit them, Maneuver or not. (The Great Clans p.168)

name: Yoritomo Bushi
skills: Commerce, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improved Weapons), Kenjutsu, Knives (Kama), Sailing, any one Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon (or pair of Knives), Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Fighters shaped by ship-to-ship combat, with fluid movement, a habit of exploiting weaknesses quickly and skill with peasant weapons that stand up to sea air.

techniques.name: The Way of the Mantis
techniques.text: Rough or uneven ground costs you nothing on movement or attacks. Fighting with improvised or Peasant-keyword weapons loses you no Honor or Glory, and a Small or Medium Peasant weapon carries no off-hand penalty. +1k0 to all attack rolls. (Core Rulebook p.120)

techniques.name: Voice of the Storm
techniques.text: Each time you hit an opponent in melee, their Armor TN against your attacks drops by 5 for 2 Rounds. It stacks up to your School Rank in times, and each new hit restarts the 2 Rounds. (Core Rulebook p.120)

techniques.name: Strike of the Mantis
techniques.text: Attacks with Samurai- or Peasant-keyword weapons are Simple Actions for you. (Core Rulebook p.120)

techniques.name: The Rolling Wave
techniques.text: Move at least 5 feet and you gain +10 Armor TN until your next Turn. On your Turn, before rolling an attack, you may give that bonus up for two Free Raises usable only on Knockdown. (Core Rulebook p.120)

techniques.name: Hand of Osano-Wo
techniques.text: For a Void Point (a Free Action), keep extra damage dice equal to your Strength; against a Prone target you also add +0k2 to the damage. (Core Rulebook p.120)

name: Yoritomo Courtier
skills: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Sincerity, any one Merchant or Lore skill
outfit: Extravagant Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: Created to serve the Mantis's trade, these courtiers rely on intimidation and bullying, a style that has found more success since the Mantis became a Great Clan.

techniques.name: Duty Before Honor
techniques.text: Using Commerce in public costs you no Honor or Glory, and Intimidation (Control) costs no Honor. Social Skill Rolls against ronin, bandits, gangsters, mercenaries, pirates and other outlaws gain Free Raises equal to your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.121)

techniques.name: Storm Heart
techniques.text: For Intimidation (Control) your Willpower counts as one Rank higher, or two against a samurai whose Status is lower than yours. (Core Rulebook p.121)

techniques.name: Command the Winds
techniques.text: As many times per session as your School Rank, a failed Sincerity Social Skill Roll may be rolled again as Intimidation (Control); the Intimidation result stands. (Core Rulebook p.121)

techniques.name: Will of the Storm
techniques.text: When you open a conversation, roll Intimidation (Control) / Willpower against their Etiquette (Courtesy) / Willpower. If you win, for the next hour they cannot spend Void Points against you and take -3k0 on Social rolls against you. Not again until that hour ends. (Core Rulebook p.121)

techniques.name: Strength in All Things
techniques.text: +5k0 whenever you use Intimidation on someone, and whenever you resist an Intimidation or Temptation roll or a Fear effect. (Core Rulebook p.121)

name: Yoritomo Shugenja
skills: Athletics, Calligraphy, Knives, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sailing (Navigation), any 1 Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 10 koku
lore: A small Yoritomo line, begun with a daughter of the Mantis founder, with an unmatched bond to the spirits of the sea and storm.

techniques.name: Child of the Sea
techniques.text: Spend a spell slot to shift the wind where you are by one degree, or a slot and a Void Point to shift the whole weather by one degree; no more slots and Void Points together each Round than your School Rank. The change reaches miles equal to your School Rank around you. Free Raise on Thunder spells. (The Great Clans p.169)

name: Toku Bushi
skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation (Search), Kenjutsu, Lore: History, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 Weapon, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: The Monkey Clan's School teaches calm against overwhelming odds and fighting many foes at once.

techniques.name: Toku’s Lesson
techniques.text: +1k0 on any Skill Roll, attacks included, against a TN of 25 or more. Your Wound penalties are reduced by your Willpower plus twice your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.222)

techniques.name: The Strength of One Man
techniques.text: +1k1 to attack and damage rolls while you face more than one opponent, or a foe of higher Insight Rank. (Core Rulebook p.222)

techniques.name: Courage Above All
techniques.text: Melee attacks are Simple Actions for you. (Core Rulebook p.222)

techniques.name: Forge Your Own Fate
techniques.text: When you are about to take Wounds, spend a Void Point to make the attacker drop the two highest dice of the damage roll, even if that leaves fewer kept dice, though never below 1k1. (Core Rulebook p.222)

techniques.name: Fortune Favors the Mortal Man
techniques.text: Once per Round, spend a Void Point to re-roll any roll at +2k1, then keep whichever of the two results you prefer. (Core Rulebook p.222)

name: Fuzake Shugenja
skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft, any one High or Merchant Skill
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 2 koku
lore: Begun as ronin shugenja in Toturi's Army under Yasuki Garou, a friend of Toku, the Fuzake swore to the Monkey Clan and devote themselves to healing and an eccentric reverence for the Fortunes.

techniques.name: The Sideways Path
techniques.text: When you cast a healing spell (one that mends Wounds, or cures poison or disease, Path to Inner Peace and Peace of the Kami among them), you may also spend Earth spell slots; each one gives a Free Raise on the Spell Casting Roll. (Secrets of the Empire p.238)

name: Tsi Smith [Artisan]
skills: Any one Artisan Skill, Commerce, two ranks in any one Craft Skill, Defense, any one Weapon Skill, any one High, Bugei, or Merchant Skill
outfit: Sensible Clothing, Wakizashi, Calligraphy Set, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Named for a foreign smith honoured by the second Emperor and revived by a ronin centuries later, the School forges weapons and armour and learns to fight so it knows how they are used.

techniques.name: Tools of the Fortunes
techniques.text: Every Craft Skill counts as a School Skill for effects that care. A successful Craft roll against a TN of at least 10 plus 5 per School Rank earns 1 point of Glory, and 1 more for each 5 by which you beat the TN. (Core Rulebook p.223)

techniques.name: Tsi Xing Guo’s Blessing
techniques.text: Using something you made yourself (a weapon in battle, a fine kimono at court), Void Points spent on the related Skill Rolls give +2k1 instead of +1k1. When an item you made is given as a gift between samurai, you and the giver each gain Glory equal to your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.223)

techniques.name: A Crafter’s Dedication
techniques.text: Crafting time is worked out from half the item’s price. When someone near you uses an item you made, you may spend a Complex Action to give them +Xk1 on the matching Skill Roll, X being your School Rank (Kenjutsu for a katana, Defense for armor, Etiquette for a kimono). (Core Rulebook p.223)

techniques.name: Exhaustive Knowledge
techniques.text: For a Void Point (a Free Action), for Rounds equal to your School Rank, attacks with a weapon you made are Simple Actions. (Core Rulebook p.223)

techniques.name: Star-filled Steel
techniques.text: Once per day, when you finish a weapon, spending every Void Point you have makes it a Sacred Weapon (as the Advantage), a Tsi weapon with one quality: Balanced (+1k0 to its attack rolls), Swift (+5 Initiative while wielded) or Unbreakable. The GM may also allow Radiant (counts as jade against Invulnerable creatures). (Core Rulebook p.223)

name: Morito Bushi
skills: Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting (Tracking), Kenjutsu, Lore: Kolat, Lore: Underworld, any one Skill
outfit: Light or Heavy Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, Heavy Weapon or Polearm, Horse (Rokugani Pony), Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: The Ox Clan's heavy cavalry, trained to ride down infantry and make the most of a horse's speed; most fight with a polearm.

techniques.name: Legacy of the Four Winds
techniques.text: While Mounted you gain +1k0 to Initiative at the start of combat and +1k0 to attack rolls. (Core Rulebook p.224)

techniques.name: The Wind Blows Many Ways
techniques.text: At the start of combat, choose Bugei Skills up to your School Rank in number; every roll that uses one gains +1k0. (Core Rulebook p.224)

techniques.name: Thunder and Fury
techniques.text: While Mounted, your attacks are Simple Actions. (Core Rulebook p.224)

techniques.name: The Blade Upon the Wind
techniques.text: Once per skirmish, for a Void Point (a Free Action), set your Initiative Score to match any other combatant’s, friend or foe. From then on it drops by 5 in the Reactions Stage of every Round until the encounter ends, and you still have only one Turn per Round. (Core Rulebook p.224)

techniques.name: Fast and Furious
techniques.text: +2k2 to attack and damage rolls against an opponent whose Initiative is lower than yours. (Core Rulebook p.224)

name: Chuda Shugenja [Snake]
skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, any 2 Skills
outfit: Robes, Wakizashi, Knife, Scroll Satchel, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: The Snake Clan's original School, founded by an Imperial magistrate sworn to destroy maho-tsukai. Its shugenja hunted Tainted sorcerers and their monsters with Earth and Jade magic.

techniques.name: To Punish the Wicked
techniques.text: For a Void Point (a Free Action), lower one target’s Reduction by your School Rank. Your spells’ damage rolls gain your School Rank against a target with the Shadowlands Taint. (Core Rulebook p.224)

name: Suzume Bushi
skills: Calligraphy, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Perform: Storytelling, any one Lore Skill, any one Skill
outfit: Light Armor, Sturdy Clothing, Daisho, any 1 weapon, Traveling Pack, 3 koku
lore: Founded from Crane samurai, the Sparrow keep a katana style that waits for the perfect strike, and their love of stories helps them read the flow of battle.

techniques.name: All Things in Time
techniques.text: At the start of a Round, before anyone acts, you may lower your Initiative Score by 5 for +1k0 on every attack and damage roll that Round. (Core Rulebook p.225)

techniques.name: Purity of Chi
techniques.text: Armor TN +5 against creatures, and against people whose Honor is lower than yours. (Core Rulebook p.225)

techniques.name: Wisdom is the Greatest Weapon
techniques.text: For a Void Point, add your Honor Rank to a Perform or Lore Skill Roll. (Core Rulebook p.225)

techniques.name: Quiet Spirit, Steady Blade
techniques.text: In the Attack Stance, your melee attacks are Simple Actions. (Core Rulebook p.225)

techniques.name: Slow and Deadly
techniques.text: In the Round after you take the Center Stance, your attack and damage rolls gain +10. Not in iaijutsu duels. (Core Rulebook p.225)

name: Kasuga Smuggler [Courtier]
skills: Commerce, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Lore: Underworld, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any one High, Merchant, or Low Skill
outfit: Extravagant Clothing, Wakizashi, any 1 weapon, Calligraphy Set, 5 koku
lore: Tortoise agents who move among the Empire's criminals, ruthless and steeped in the underworld, finding allies wherever they can, even among honest peasants.

techniques.name: Way of the Tortoise
techniques.text: At character creation each purchase of the Languages Advantage also brings one gaijin language free. While serving your clan you lose no Honor for Low Skills and no Glory for using Commerce in public. +2k0 on all Social Skill Rolls with heimin and hinin (peasants, merchants, eta). (Core Rulebook p.227)

techniques.name: The Shell of the Tortoise
techniques.text: A clan or Imperial samurai who attacks or openly slanders you unprovoked (the GM decides) at once loses Honor points equal to twice your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.227)

techniques.name: The Eyes of the Emperor
techniques.text: While acting for your clan, roll extra unkept dice, as many as your School Rank, on any Low Skill in which you have at least 1 Rank, including School Skills that count as Low when used a certain way (Sincerity with Deceit). Skill Ranks that come from Advantages or Techniques (such as Crafty) do not count. (Core Rulebook p.227)

techniques.name: Hand in Hand
techniques.text: Once per session, if you can reach the local heimin or hinin, a Lore: Underworld / Awareness roll at TN 25 tells you one useful fact, chosen by the GM, that no other route would give you. (Core Rulebook p.227)

techniques.name: The Tortoise Smiles
techniques.text: Your Void does not cap your Raises on rolls with your six named School Skills. As many times per session as your Void, gain +5k0 when rolling any of your School Skills; this stacks with your Rank 3 Technique. (Core Rulebook p.227)

name: Yotsu Bushi School (Heroes of Rokugan) [Bushi]
skills: Commerce, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any one Skill from Lore: Gaijin or Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Low or Bugei Skill
outfit: Daisho, Light or Ashigaru Armor, two other weapons, Sturdy Clothing, Traveling Pack, 4 koku
source: Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline
lore: From the ronin family that guarded the commoners of Otosan Uchi, the School grew into a full bushi style while fighting the Spider in the capital's ruins. In the Heroes of Rokugan timeline the Yotsu become the Tiger Clan.

techniques.name: The Tiger's Tread
techniques.text: Against enemies of the Empire, halve Honor losses from the Ambush and Shadowing uses of Stealth, rounding down. In urban areas, including ruins, gain +1k0 to Stealth and add Stealth Rank to Armor TN. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)

techniques.name: The Tiger's Pounce
techniques.text: In the first Round of a skirmish, add Stealth Rank to Initiative. This bonus ends at the Reactions Stage. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)

techniques.name: Rending Claws
techniques.text: Make attacks with Samurai weapons as Simple Actions. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)

techniques.name: Shelter the Blameless (Yotsu Bushi)
techniques.text: While actively defending or protecting another person, as determined by the GM, gain 1 bonus Void Point for that Round. Any unspent bonus point expires at the end of the Round. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)

techniques.name: The Tiger's Fangs
techniques.text: During the first Round of a skirmish, Maneuvers require one fewer Raise. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)

name: The Four Temples [Monk]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Monks who believe enlightenment requires staying engaged with society. With a great monastery in the Imperial capital, they advise lords and help travellers.

techniques.name: Soul of Civility
techniques.text: When you spend a Void Point to augment a High Skill Roll or a Social Skill Roll, you gain +2k2 instead of the normal +1k1.

name: The Order of Heroes [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (pick an Emphasis), Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A little-known sect that believes anyone can become a hero. It quietly finds threats to the Empire and the people able to meet them.

techniques.name: Destiny’s Hand
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to give one ally who has not yet taken his Turn +1k1 on any one roll this Round. Never a roll that cannot normally benefit from Void Points, such as a damage roll.

name: The Shrine of the Seven Thunders [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Monks who honour the seven heroes who defeated Fu Leng by devoting their lives to contemplation, rarely leaving their monastery.

techniques.name: Walk with the Prophet
techniques.text: All three of your starting Kiho must be chosen from a single Element, and your Insight Rank counts as one higher for meeting the Mastery Level of Kiho from that Element.

name: The Temple of Kaimetsu-uo [Monk]
skills: Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any three Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Followers of the Mantis founder who believe he left to avoid a ruinous fight over the Crab's leadership; they seek enlightenment through conciliation and peace.

techniques.name: The Path of Purity
techniques.text: In a Contested Social Skill Roll your opponent initiated, you may use any Ring in place of the Trait normally used (typically Awareness).

name: The Temple of Osano-Wo [Monk]
skills: Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any two Bugei Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Perhaps the most militant Brotherhood sect, devoted to physical prowess and martial arts; its monks ritually scar themselves to mark their progress.

techniques.name: The Hand of Thunder
techniques.text: Gain +0k1 to all damage rolls from unarmed attacks, cumulative with any other effect that lets you roll or keep extra dice on unarmed damage.

name: The Temples of the Thousand Fortunes [Monk]
skills: Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A varied network of temples to Rokugan's countless Fortunes, whose monks mostly believe they must work hard to prove worthy of enlightenment.

techniques.name: The Thousand Forms
techniques.text: You begin play knowing four Kiho rather than the usual three. These four do not count against the additional Kiho you may purchase with Experience Points.

name: Order of the Wind [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Staves, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Brothers who accept that the world is chaotic and unpredictable and stay steady within it, gaining command of themselves and, quietly, a little of the world around them.

techniques.name: Essence of the Wind
techniques.text: Any effect that targets you and tries to influence your behaviour — spell, courtier Technique, Social Skill, Advantage or anything else — costs its user an additional Void Point to take effect, and that extra point may bypass the normal one-per-Round limit on enhancement effects.

name: Wind’s Grace Order [Monk]
skills: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Formed after the Clan War for monks who could not regain their peace after defending the temples. Archery gave them focus, and the order keeps ties to the Asahina and other archery traditions.

techniques.name: Pillars of the Mind’s Eye
techniques.text: Make an archery attack as a Complex Action, gaining +1k0 for each Kiho you currently have active (only one Martial Kiho counts, and active Kiho may have no other effect that Round). If the attack directly kills an intelligent being you lose 3 points of Honor.

name: Fukurokujin’s Eyes [Monk]
skills: Calligraphy, Divination, Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, any one non-Bugei Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A hereditary order of a few bloodlines descended from a tribe older than the Kami's arrival, valued by the Crab for uncannily accurate judgement and prediction.

techniques.name: Way of the Closed Eye
techniques.text: You cannot be surprised by an ambush. Before Initiative is rolled you may spend a Void Point and roll Perception at TN 20 to raise your Initiative Score by 20 — a bonus lost the instant you make any attack.

name: The Order of the Nameless Gift [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: An offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders that seeks the Thunders' fate-changing power in every soul through physical rigour and trials of endurance, taking the world plainly as it is.

techniques.name: Shinsei’s Gift
techniques.text: You gain Void Points per day equal to your Earth Ring, spendable only to reduce damage or to raise your Armor TN, never simultaneously with other Void Points or in any other way. This sheet does not track that separate pool for you.

name: Temple of Persistence [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Martial Arts), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A largely martial order devoted to unyielding endurance. Its training tests body, mind and spirit to their limits, and its stubborn monks rarely accept defeat.

techniques.name: Unyielding Spirit
techniques.text: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to ignore all penalties to the very next roll. If that roll is an Attack Roll, or a Contested Roll you did not initiate, also add +Xk0 where X is your Earth Ring.

name: The Order of Rebirth [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Descended from militant sohei of Osano-Wo, these brothers embrace new paths and philosophies to uncover new truths, earning other sects' disdain.

techniques.name: Changing the Way
techniques.text: Each time in an encounter that you activate a Kiho of a different Element from every Kiho already used that encounter, you gain +5 on the activation roll.

name: Tengoku’s Fist [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A friendly offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders, these sohei see violence as a natural part of life: never a first resort, but an option they use exceptionally well.

techniques.name: The Hand of the Heavens
techniques.text: When attacking unarmed, or with a bisento, a bo staff, or any weapon with the Monk property, gain a Free Raise on the attack roll if your Fire Ring exceeds your opponent’s.

name: The Temple of Heavenly Wisdom [Monk]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sincerity, any one High Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Perhaps the oldest monastic tradition in Crane lands. Its ancient temple helped the Lady Doji spread culture and won its monks unusual prestige.

techniques.name: The Largesse of Fukurokujin
techniques.text: On any Social Skill Roll, name one Kiho you know: you may not use it for the rest of the day, but you gain +1k1 on the roll. Each Kiho may be spent this way only once per day.

name: The Order of Jurojin’s Blessing [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Anatomy (Disease), Medicine (Disease, Herbalism), Meditation, Staves, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Founded during the Great Famine to tend the sick of every caste; some members also treat injuries and, in later centuries, madness.

techniques.name: Blessings of Longevity
techniques.text: +1k1 on Medicine rolls to treat disease or infection and +1k0 to treat Wounds. You may also attempt to treat natural, non-Taint insanity with a Medicine roll, though whether it helps is your GM’s call.

name: The Shrine of Heaven’s Mirror [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Divination (Omens), Jiujutsu, Lore: Omens, Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Ascetics who seek trance states, through sleeplessness, drink, wild dance and visionary plants, to receive guidance from the Fortunes and spirits, above all through omens.

techniques.name: Gaze into the Mirror
techniques.text: +1k0 on all Divination rolls, or +1k1 when interpreting an omen. Once per day you may spend a Void Point to interpret an omen with absolute accuracy and no roll — though what the omen truly means remains your GM’s call.

name: The Order of Eternity [Monk]
skills: Defense, Divination (Astrology), Jiujutsu, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any two High Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Monks who study the nature of time and wait for the right moment to act. Their long stillness and sudden action can make them seem odd, even mad.

techniques.name: The Touch of Eternity
techniques.text: Contemplate a non-combat situation for as long as your GM requires, then roll Meditation / Void at TN 25 or higher. On a success gain +1k1 +Void on Skill Rolls made to resolve that specific situation, for no more rolls than your Void Rank before further contemplation is needed.

name: Shinmaki Order [Monk]
skills: Divination, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Diamond Sutra), Meditation 2, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A small, controversial sect that studies the Diamond Sutra and meditates on the Seven Thunders in dark, isolated monasteries, emerging only now and then.

techniques.name: The Diamond Sutra
techniques.text: You start play with the Disturbing Countenance Disadvantage for no points, and gain +1k0 to Meditation rolls, Fear rolls, and all Social Skill Rolls with heimin and hinin. You lose no Honor for touching dead flesh, though Glory and Infamy change as normal.

name: First Dawn Scholars [Monk]
skills: Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Nonhumans, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, Staves, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: In the Togashi Dynasty setting, the Owl Clan's monastic order: keepers of a library on civilisations older than humanity, who seek enlightenment in the world before the Kami fell.

techniques.name: Way of the Ancient World
techniques.text: You may learn one additional Mystical Kiho, and gain +1k0 on all Etiquette and Lore Skill rolls.

name: Order of the Five Rings [Monk]
skills: Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Elements, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: A short-lived order devoted to the charismatic monk Gorinno and his heretical philosophy, its members growing ever more zealous and cult-like.

techniques.name: Cracks within the Elements
techniques.text: On any attack roll or Social Skill Roll against a mortal opponent, add twice the difference between that opponent’s highest and lowest Rings to your total.

name: Fudoist Order [Monk]
skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any two Skills
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Monks of Fudoism, a heresy the Brotherhood of Shinsei has banned. Each must choose a personal path, and their Technique turns the gap in Honor between them and a foe into an edge.

techniques.name: For Each, One Path
techniques.text: At character creation choose a low or high starting Honor Rank, and choose to specialise in either opposed Social Skill Rolls or Attack rolls. You gain a bonus to that roll type equal to twice the difference between your Honor Rank and your opponent’s.

name: Order of Peaceful Repose [Monk]
skills: Athletics, Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Lore: Ghosts, Lore: Theology (Emma-O), Meditation, any one Skill
outfit: Bo (or pair of jo), coarse plain Traveling Clothing, Scroll Satchel with passages from the Tao, 2 zeni
lore: Monks of Emma-O who lay ghosts to rest wherever war or local conditions make them common, whether the dead were peasants or samurai.

techniques.name: Emma-O’s Insight
techniques.text: Spend 10 minutes in meditation and roll Meditation / Awareness at TN 25 to detect the presence of ghosts — yorei or goryo, though not gaki. Usable a number of times per day equal to your Void Rank, and Raises on the roll reveal further detail.
